objective: Maximize qualified visitor-to-signed-agreement-and-paid-deposit conversion while safely replacing fragmented Supabase, Payload, and Directus responsibilities with a Convex-centered operating system.
invariants: persist authoritative state before acknowledging success
authentication establishes identity; Convex authorization controls access
no protected read or write relies on frontend-only checks
external side effects require idempotency, provider receipts, retry classification, and visible failure state
no destructive migration before snapshots, reconciliation, rollback, and approval gates
no production promotion when lead, authz, proposal, deposit, private-file, or canonical-route checks fail
customer data is isolated by resource ownership and organization/property/project scope
AI output is advisory only for pricing, legal, identity, permission, refund, completion, and financial truth

loop.name: SYNC-SELECT-PLAN-EXECUTE-VERIFY-PROMOTE-OBSERVE-LEARN
loop.purpose: Execute one review-sized node at a time while preserving parallelism across independent resource locks.

states.name: SYNC
states.exit: repository, deployment, graph state, incidents, and provider status match external truth

states.name: SELECT
states.exit: highest-value ready node or conflict-free batch selected

states.name: PLAN
states.exit: entry criteria, files, interfaces, failing tests, rollback, and evidence contract are explicit

states.name: EXECUTE
states.exit: minimal implementation completes the node contract

states.name: VERIFY
states.exit: local, integration, preview, domain-specific, and independent review checks pass

states.name: PROMOTE
states.exit: change is merged/deployed behind the correct gate or flag

states.name: OBSERVE
states.exit: production or shadow metrics satisfy primary and guardrail thresholds

states.name: LEARN
states.exit: graph state, artifacts, deviations, and next-node scores are updated

failureTransitions.condition: node is too large, ambiguous, or conflicts with another active node
new constraint or interface mismatch discovered
verification failure is within node scope
failureTransitions.action: diagnose, add failing regression test, patch
block node and create/unblock prerequisite node
rollback, preserve evidence, create incident record
close node and recalculate ready set

wipPolicy.mergePolicy: merge only one node per PR unless the nodes share one inseparable acceptance test

loop.selectionFormula: priority*10 + businessValue*30 + risk*20 + downstreamUnblocks*12 - sizeCost*18 - blastRadius*10
selectionRules: only select nodes whose start dependencies are done or gates passed
never select two nodes sharing a resource lock
prefer a conflict-free batch spanning different workstreams
a large or extra-large node must first emit a bite-sized implementation plan
do not allow a node to close until completionRequires are done
human-assisted nodes may be prepared by agents but cannot pass without owner evidence
